SELECT
    JournalEntryItem.Type AS JE_Type,
    JournalEntryItem.HomeCurrency AS JE_Currency,
    JournalEntry.AccountLegalentity__s AS Legal_Entity,
    JournalEntry.Journalentrydate AS Start_Date,
    AccountingCode.Name AS Accounting_Code,
    YEAR(JournalEntry.Journalentrydate) AS Year_Indicator,  -- Added Year Indicator
 
    -- Total Debit Calculation
    SUM(CASE WHEN JournalEntryItem.Type = 'Debit'
             THEN JournalEntryItem.AmountHomeCurrency ELSE 0 END) AS Debit,
 
    -- Total Credit Calculation
    SUM(CASE WHEN JournalEntryItem.Type = 'Credit'
             THEN JournalEntryItem.AmountHomeCurrency ELSE 0 END) AS Credit,
 
    -- Balance Calculation
    (SUM(CASE WHEN JournalEntryItem.Type = 'Debit'
              THEN JournalEntryItem.AmountHomeCurrency ELSE 0 END) -
     SUM(CASE WHEN JournalEntryItem.Type = 'Credit'
              THEN JournalEntryItem.AmountHomeCurrency ELSE 0 END)) AS Balance_EUR,
 
    -- Cumulative Balance Calculation (Fixed)
    SUM(
        SUM(CASE WHEN JournalEntryItem.Type = 'Debit'
                 THEN JournalEntryItem.AmountHomeCurrency ELSE 0 END) -
        SUM(CASE WHEN JournalEntryItem.Type = 'Credit'
                 THEN JournalEntryItem.AmountHomeCurrency ELSE 0 END)
    ) OVER (
        PARTITION BY YEAR(JournalEntry.Journalentrydate)  -- Separate calculation for each year
        ORDER BY JournalEntry.Journalentrydate ASC
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS Cumulative_Balance_EUR
 
FROM JournalEntryItem
JOIN JournalEntry
    ON JournalEntryItem.JournalEntryId = JournalEntry.Id
JOIN AccountingCode
    ON JournalEntryItem.AccountingCodeId = AccountingCode.Id
JOIN AccountingPeriod
    ON JournalEntry.AccountingPeriodId = AccountingPeriod.Id
 
-- Filters for Previous Year and Current Year
WHERE AccountingCode.Name IN ('Installment plan', 'Installment plan - Lumea', 'Installment plan - Sonicare')
AND YEAR(JournalEntry.Journalentrydate) IN (YEAR(CURRENT_DATE), YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 1)  -- Fetch only last two years
 
GROUP BY
    JournalEntryItem.Type,
    JournalEntryItem.HomeCurrency,
    JournalEntry.AccountLegalentity__s,
    AccountingCode.Name,
    JournalEntry.Journalentrydate,
    YEAR(JournalEntry.Journalentrydate)
 
ORDER BY Year_Indicator ASC, JournalEntry.Journalentrydate ASC

SELECT 
    JournalEntryItem.Type AS journal_entry_type, 
    JournalEntryItem.Currency AS journal_entry_currency, 
    JournalEntry.AccountLegalEntity AS account_legal_entity, 
    JournalEntry.AccountingPeriodStartDate AS accounting_period_start_date, 
    JournalEntryItem.TransactionType AS transaction_type, 
    JournalEntryItem.AccountingCodeName AS accounting_code_name, 
    SUM(JournalEntryItem.Amount) AS total_amount,

    -- Total Debit Calculation
    SUM(CASE WHEN JournalEntryItem.TransactionType = 'Debit' 
             THEN JournalEntryItem.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_debit,

    -- Total Credit Calculation
    SUM(CASE WHEN JournalEntryItem.TransactionType = 'Credit' 
             THEN JournalEntryItem.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_credit,

    -- Cumulative Balance Calculation
    SUM(JournalEntryItem.Amount) 
        OVER (PARTITION BY JournalEntry.AccountLegalEntity, JournalEntryItem.Currency 
              ORDER BY JournalEntry.AccountingPeriodStartDate) AS cumulative_balance

FROM JournalEntryItem
JOIN JournalEntry ON JournalEntryItem.JournalEntryId = JournalEntry.Id

WHERE JournalEntry.AccountingPeriodStartDate >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '12' MONTH) 
AND JournalEntry.AccountLegalEntity IN ('NL', 'DE', 'PL', 'GB', 'US', 'CA')
AND JournalEntry.RunStatus = 'Completed'

GROUP BY 
    JournalEntryItem.Type, 
    JournalEntryItem.Currency, 
    JournalEntry.AccountLegalEntity, 
    JournalEntry.AccountingPeriodStartDate, 
    JournalEntryItem.TransactionType, 
    JournalEntryItem.AccountingCodeName

ORDER BY JournalEntry.AccountingPeriodStartDate ASC

SELECT 
    s.Id AS subscription_id,  
    rp.Name AS product_name, 
    rp.RatePlanPhilips12NC__c AS old_CTN, 
    rp.Id AS rate_plan_id, 
    s.SubscriptionStatus__c AS status  
FROM Subscription s
JOIN RatePlan rpl ON s.Id = rpl.SubscriptionId
JOIN ProductRatePlan rp ON rpl.ProductRatePlanId = rp.Id
WHERE s.SubscriptionStatus__c = 'Active'  
AND rp.RatePlanPhilips12NC__c IN (
    'HX6052/10', 'HX6062/10', 'HX6062/13', 'HX9042/17', 'HX9042/33', 
    'HX9052/17', 'HX9052/33', 'HX9092/10', 'HX9092/11', 'HX6054/10', 
    'HX6064/10', 'HX6064/11', 'HX9044/17', 'HX9044/33', 'HX9054/17', 
    'HX9054/33', 'HX9094/10', 'HX9094/11'
)

select Account.Legalentity__c from Account
GROUP BY Legalentity__c

SELECT
    sub.Name                        as subName,
    sub.AutoRenew                   as subAutoRenew,
    sub.Status                      as subStatus,
    sub.CurrentTerm                 as subCurrentTerm,
    sub.CurrentTermPeriodType       as subCurrentTermPeriodType,
    sub.TermType                    as subTermType,
    sub.SubscriptionStartDate       as subStartDate,    
    sub.SubscriptionEndDate         as subEndDate,    
    sub.TermStartDate               as subTermStartDate,    
    sub.TermEndDate                 as subTermEndDate
FROM
    Subscription                    AS sub
